rows.grounds: root vicint (think) with gerund ending -ya; indeclinable participle
causative prabhedaya with optative ending -et; break open

items.question: What should the practitioner do after visualizing the support with a steady mind?
premises: support is to be broken open
items.inference: The practitioner contemplates the support steadily, then breaks it open.
uncertainties: exact referent of support unclear from this verse alone
items.plain_english: Having considered with a steady mind, one should break open the support.
